content:
I am excited to share LeanExplore, a new Mathlib search engine that combines semantic search embeddings, AI-generated translations, and PageRank to give optimized search results.

Try it out live at: https://www.leanexplore.com

I also created a discussion thread.

I have some exciting updates for LeanExplore (https://www.leanexplore.com) to share!

  • Smarter Search: Now LeanExplore uses a combination of semantic search, PageRank, and BM25+ for improved results. For the query "finite type morphism schemes", 9/10 results are now topical versus 2/10 before.
  • Broader Scope: Search across more Lean 4 packages (Mathlib, Batteries, Std, etc.) and filter by package.
  • New Python Package: Programmatic access and API! Check out the repository.
  • Chat with LeanExplore: You can either chat in the CLI via leanexplore chat, or you can integrate LeanExplore into any application that supports MCP, such as Claude Desktop. See here.
  • Research Paper: Read about the algorithms behind LeanExplore in the report.

As before, here is the discussion thread
